changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetIntersectTypeNames] ( @id int ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( SELECT COALESCE(SI.Name, SRef.Name, SATT.Name, '') + ' [' + coalesce(P.Name,'/') + '] ' + COALESCE(ORef.Name, OATT.Name, '') as Name FROM [IntersectType] I left join AssetType SATT on SATT.[Object] = I.Subject and SATT.[ObjectID] = I.SubjectID left join AssetType OATT on OATT.[Object] = I.[Object] and OATT.[ObjectID] = I.ObjectID left join ( SELECT I_sub.ID, COALESCE( SATT_sub.Name, '') + ' [' + coalesce(P_sub.Name,'/') + '] ' + COALESCE( OATT_sub.Name, '') as Name FROM [IntersectType] I_sub left join AssetType SATT_sub on SATT_sub.[Object] = I_sub.Subject and SATT_sub.[ObjectID] = I_sub.SubjectID left join AssetType OATT_sub on OATT_sub.[Object] = I_sub.[Object] and OATT_sub.[ObjectID] = I_sub.ObjectID left join [Predicate] P_sub on P_sub.ID = I_sub.PredicateID
) SI on (I.Subject = 'IntersectType' and SI.ID = I.SubjectID)
left join ( select 0 as ID, 'Reference Item Type' as Name ) SRef on I.Subject = 'ReferenceItemType' and I.SubjectID = 0
left join ( select 0 as ID, 'Reference Item Type' as Name ) ORef on I.Object = 'ReferenceItemType' and I.ObjectID = 0 left join [Predicate] P on P.ID = I.PredicateID WHERE I.ID = @id )
changeSet.rollback:
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetIntersectTypeNames] ( @id int ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( SELECT COALESCE(SF.TextPath, SI.Name, SRef.Name, SATT.Name, '') + ' [' + coalesce(P.Name,'/') + '] ' + COALESCE([OF].TextPath, ORef.Name, OATT.Name, '') as Name FROM [IntersectType] I left join AssetType SATT on SATT.[Object] = I.Subject and SATT.[ObjectID] = I.SubjectID and SATT.[Object] != 'FusionAttributeType' left join AssetType OATT on OATT.[Object] = I.[Object] and OATT.[ObjectID] = I.ObjectID and OATT.[Object] != 'FusionAttributeType'
left join [FusionAttributeType] SF on I.Subject = 'FusionAttributeType' and SF.ID = I.SubjectID left join [FusionAttributeType] [OF] on I.Object = 'FusionAttributeType' and [OF].ID = I.ObjectID
left join ( SELECT I_sub.ID, COALESCE(SF_sub.TextPath, SATT_sub.Name, '') + ' [' + coalesce(P_sub.Name,'/') + '] ' + COALESCE([OF_sub].TextPath, OATT_sub.Name, '') as Name FROM [IntersectType] I_sub left join AssetType SATT_sub on SATT_sub.[Object] = I_sub.Subject and SATT_sub.[ObjectID] = I_sub.SubjectID and SATT_sub.[Object] != 'FusionAttributeType' left join AssetType OATT_sub on OATT_sub.[Object] = I_sub.[Object] and OATT_sub.[ObjectID] = I_sub.ObjectID and OATT_sub.[Object] != 'FusionAttributeType'
left join [FusionAttributeType] SF_sub on I_sub.Subject = 'FusionAttributeType' and SF_sub.ID = I_sub.SubjectID left join [FusionAttributeType] [OF_sub] on I_sub.Object = 'FusionAttributeType' and [OF_sub].ID = I_sub.ObjectID
left join [Predicate] P_sub on P_sub.ID = I_sub.PredicateID
) SI on (I.Subject = 'IntersectType' and SI.ID = I.SubjectID)
left join ( select 0 as ID, 'Reference Item Type' as Name ) SRef on I.Subject = 'ReferenceItemType' and I.SubjectID = 0
left join ( select 0 as ID, 'Reference Item Type' as Name ) ORef on I.Object = 'ReferenceItemType' and I.ObjectID = 0
left join [Predicate] P on P.ID = I.PredicateID WHERE I.ID = @id )
